name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Transporter 13 (Dedicated SSO Rideshare)
description: Dedicated rideshare flight to a sun-synchronous orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 booster B1081 has returned to the launch site at LZ-4 after its 13th flight.
